original_population.ordering: level, declared variant order, mirror_group_id, mirror_pair_member, episode_index
original_population.scope: ALL frozen existing development validation records, not a sampled easier subset. Preserve existing singleton groups (notably L5), all complete mirrors, invalid/failed/time-out episodes. Existing development corpus is NOT untouched holdout. L7 both variants retained; L0 not mixed into the main8Level aggregate.

fresh_new_scene_development.geometry_source: Unchanged public V16 four-axis specification on FRESH identities. No V16/V28 scenes or labels reused for new-model evaluation; no geometry/capture/response-based scene filtering, replacement or parameter search.
fresh_new_scene_development.groups_across_axes: Same8 layout/noise groups and mirror members across all4 axes,64 episodes. Noise may diverge after different policies consume different histories; pairing asserts identical initial/noise seeds, not identical realized future noise.

reserved_holdout_not_collected.geometry: Original reserved S4 wallx1.5 distribution, unchanged V28 public speed/observation/scene variation specification;16 episodes.
reserved_holdout_not_collected.release_condition: Only fixed V28 primary passed full independent artifact replay AND all predeclared closed-loop development capture/safety/latency gates. One frozen confirmation, no tuning, no best seed/epoch/gate switching, no reuse after failure. Not generated or inspected by the baseline entry.

method_order: Rotate fixed method list by SHA256(cohort/episode_index) mod7 to reduce systematic order bias; identical complete scene population and initial/environment/controller sampling seeds for all methods. No best-method selection.
model_selection: Only independently replayed V28 archive, fixed final80epoch, all3seeds retained and preregistered ADE-median chosen per configuration. Failed primary prohibits active evaluation. Matched primary frozen common defines own_motion; independent ADE-median motion/L2 controls also reported. Never activate failed V23 teacher as scorer.
proposal_library: Unchanged V29 common fixed failed V23 PUBLIC proposer/V27 shared bound24 candidates/2 rounds for EVERY expanded scoring control. Original is unexpanded original solver. Libraries regenerate from each method's actual received context; later closed-loop states differ, so this is a paired POLICY comparison, not a claim of identical realized libraries at diverged states. Exact same-library response contribution already requires V28 all-call offline comparisons.
primary_outcome: Restricted safe-capture time in seconds: actual safe capture time if safe_capture_success with no collision/boundary/target-invalid episode, otherwise fixed original25s horizon. Failed/invalid/timeout episodes retained, never conditional-on-success timing. Positive paired baseline_time-primary_time means improvement.
aggregation: Original primary aggregate is equal-weight8Level mean of equal-weight declared variants, then existing mirror-group means; L7 two variants equal-weight and L0 separately diagnostic. Fresh axes equal-weight4variants then8 shared layout groups; all per-level/per-variant absolute capture/safety/failure metrics reported. No treating sequential calls/windows as independent scenes.

development_gates.confidence_scope: Fixed population group-resampling descriptive intervals, not formal safety/generalization proof. Stratify original variants/levels and fresh shared layout groups. ALL required checks, both original and new-scene cohorts, must pass. Primary cannot switch to another configuration/control.

holdout_confirmation: Same fixed restricted-time positive lower95 vs original/own_motion/L2, safe-capture noninferiority lower95>=-0.02 and no additional collision/boundary/target-invalid/local-failure outcomes and fixed latency p95<=100ms. Small8group uncertainty reported. No post-holdout gate changes or deployment promotion from a failed confirmation.
latency: CPU original environment, original GRU252/DN-MPC/local CBF, torch1thread. ALL research capture-copy/proposal/inference/full original score time stays inside original planner timeout; IO outside plan still included in end-to-end latency. Preload/readiness time reported separately. No subtraction, deadline relaxation, fake clocks or timing claims from synthetic tests. Original native timing fields and actual observer cycle timing retained; first/warmup timing support disclosed.
diagnostic_serialization: Legacy nonfinite diagnostics (for example no-obstacle infinity) retain explicit tagged JSON values, never converted to zero, silently dropped or fed to a model. Physical outcomes and required time/cost metrics remain validated; numerical trajectories are saved unchanged.
baseline_collection_allowed: Only complete original development population with EXACT unchanged original classes. May run before V28 qualification. Published exact protocol/source commit required BEFORE new baseline outputs. Never calls/generates fresh or reserved holdout scenes.
remaining: Implement/check actual paired active evaluation runner and fixed statistical/latency gate entry, independent model-fault equivalence, new-scene generation, sealed holdout confirmation and complete result archive/replay. This protocol or baseline-only run is NOT causal-model efficacy, active control qualification or new formal CBF safety proof.
